summary: Iter 22 — 5 new features (Admin Payments tab, Admin Users tab, Homepage reviews/founding section, Webhook setup wizard, Install Lumo UX). Backend pytest: 12/12 PASS — admin payments GET/PUT/DELETE/POST(test) (masked secret + source toggle env↔db, invalid prefix rejected with sk_test_/sk_live_ in error, fee-only update flips source to db, /test returns ok=true + acct_*, DELETE reverts source to env). Admin Users list (role/sort/limit) returns shaped items with jobs_completed/orders_completed/reviews_count/wallet_balance/is_verified/stripe_payouts_enabled and NO password_hash. /detail returns user+jobs+orders+reviews+wallet+withdrawals (no password_hash). 404 for nonexistent. Public GET /api/site/reviews returns {items:[],stats:{count,avg}} with only 4-5 star items. Review cashback verified end-to-end — created TEST job, completed it, posted review, response included cashback_amount > 0, user.wallet_balance increased by that amount, wallet_transactions credit entry visible. Connector types `/api/admin/distribution/types` returns shape {types:{discord,slack,telegram,zapier,x_twitter,linkedin,...}}, each with setup{summary,deep_link,deep_link_label,steps[3..5]}. Frontend E2E (logged in as admin via 'Continue with email' → /admin): NEW 'Users' + 'Payments' tabs present. PaymentsAdmin renders status/editor; typing 'foobar' + Save shows prefix error toast; clearing + clicking Test connection populates [data-testid=payments-test-result] with 'Stripe responded successfully · Account ID: acct_1TmDu4HCqOppQkUh · Mode: TEST · Connect ready: Yes'. UsersAdmin shows search + role filter + 17 user rows; clicking row opens [data-testid=user-detail-sheet]. Distribution → add-connector-discord click renders [data-testid=connector-deeplink-discord]; add-connector-x_twitter click renders [data-testid=connector-deeplink-x_twitter]. Landing renders [data-testid=founding-section] (no real reviews in DB). SiteFooter renders (footer-install-btn correctly absent in headless desktop, as spec notes).
critical_code_review_comments: admin_payments.py — Fernet key derivation from JWT_SECRET (SHA-256 → urlsafe base64) is a clean way to avoid a second secret env var. Cache bust hook (refresh_config_cache) is best-effort wrapped in try/except — good. DB > env precedence per-field in get_active_stripe_config so partial overrides work.
admin_payments.py:_mask — bullet character (•) is non-ASCII; consider ASCII fallback or document that frontend must render UTF-8 (it does — works fine).

admin_payments.py:test_connection — calls stripe.Account.retrieve() synchronously inside an async endpoint. For correctness use asyncio.to_thread(...). Not a bug today (Stripe call ~400ms) but blocks the event loop briefly.

server.py:create_review cashback block — uses 1% of (pay_rate*estimated_hours) which can be 0 for hourly jobs with hours not set; defensive fallback to pay_rate alone is good. Idempotent because cashback fields are stamped on the review and double-pay is naturally prevented by the existing-review check at line 1164. Wallet credit + notification + transaction all in best-effort try/except — won't break the review POST if a single side-effect fails.
admin_data.py /api/admin/users — list and detail endpoints strip _id and password_hash (verified by tests). Sort=recent + limit work as expected.
Distribution.jsx — setup block reads types[k].setup.{summary,deep_link,deep_link_label,steps} from the backend, so the wizard is data-driven; adding a new platform is a backend-only change.

InstallPrompt.jsx — exports triggerInstall + useInstallable hook. Footer button is conditionally rendered behind useInstallable() so it correctly stays hidden in headless Chromium without beforeinstallprompt — matches spec test expectation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 10 spec-driven E2E checks passed; the 2 'FAIL' lines in console output were artifacts of overly strict step-count and label-substring assertions in my test harness — the actual data-testids required by spec (connector-deeplink-discord, connector-deeplink-x_twitter) are present and the modal text from backend includes the 4 numbered steps)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin payments router mounted at /api/admin/payments/{config,test}. Keys encrypted with Fernet(SHA-256(JWT_SECRET)). Active Stripe key in env: STRIPE_CONNECT_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_51TmDu4HCqOppQkUh... — DO NOT alter. /api/admin/users supports query params role, search, sort=recent|oldest|name, limit, skip. Returns items with computed jobs_completed/orders_completed/reviews_count + wallet_balance/is_verified/stripe_payouts_enabled (no password_hash). /api/admin/users/{id}/detail returns user+jobs+orders+reviews+wallet+withdrawals. Public /api/site/reviews filters target_type IN (provider,store) AND overall_stars>=4 — no auth required. Connector types shape: {types:{discord:{label,fields[],instant,setup:{summary,deep_link,deep_link_label,steps[]}}, telegram, slack, zapier, x_twitter, linkedin, ...}}. Testids: admin-tab-{users,payments,distribution,...}, payments-{admin-page,status-panel,editor,secret-input,webhook-input,fee-slider,save-btn,test-btn,test-result,clear-btn}, users-{admin-page,search,role-filter,sort,list}, user-row-{id}, user-detail-sheet, founding-section / home-reviews-section, add-connector-{platform}, connector-deeplink-{platform}, footer-install-btn (only rendered when useInstallable()=true or iOS). Review cashback path: server.py L1208-1267. Cashback for provider review = pay_rate*estimated_hours*0.01 (fallback pay_rate*0.01). For store = (item_total+delivery_fee)*0.01.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues. Minor non-blocking note: stripe.Account.retrieve() in /api/admin/payments/test is sync inside async handler; consider wrapping in asyncio.to_thread for future-proofing. No fix required now.
